text:
Procurement decisions require clean visibility into spend, suppliers, contracts, quality and delivery.
Raw purchase-order exports are difficult to validate, normalize and analyze consistently.
ProcureSight converts 47,128 purchase orders into verified decision intelligence.
Deterministic analytics remain the source of truth; AI only explains confirmed findings.
